title: external-dns (koorikla wrapper)
description: Platform keys only; the upstream external-dns subchart, cluster.* and installation keys stay open. Cross-field rules: templates/validate.yaml.

external-dns.description: Upstream kubernetes-sigs/external-dns subchart values (guarded in templates/validate.yaml, not constrained here).

role.description: mgmt or workload: workload clusters read the Cloudflare token only from store dns.

dns.description: installation.yaml dns.*: the DNS provider and the zones ExternalDNS may manage.

provider.description: DNS provider of the installation (empty: none).

secrets.description: Cloudflare token via ESO (merged with installation.yaml secrets.*).

store.description: ClusterSecretStore of the token: platform on mgmt, dns on workload clusters.
